name: LinkedIn Authority System - Intake to Follow-Up Tracker

parameters.content:
# LinkedIn Authority System - Intake to Follow-Up Tracker

Manual-trigger v1 proof lane. This workflow does not post to LinkedIn, scrape LinkedIn, auto-send DMs, or send email. It normalizes one test signal, checks claim boundaries, builds tracker row payloads, prepares a follow-up task, and returns a final local review packet.

parameters.jsCode:
return items.map((item) => {
  const n = item.json.normalized;
  const campaign_row = {
    'Campaign ID': n.campaign_id,
    'Status': n.campaign_status,
    'Campaign Name': n.campaign_name,
    'Owner': n.owner,
    'Start Date': n.start_date,
    'End Date': '',
    'Target Buyer': n.target_buyer,
    'Core Problem': n.core_problem,
    'CTA': n.cta_label,
    'CTA Link': n.cta_url,
    'Goal': 'Dogfood the tracker and first n8n lane',
    'Notes': item.json.normalization_warnings.join(' | ')
  };
  const post_row = {
    'Post ID': n.post_id,
    'Campaign ID': n.campaign_id,
    'Status': n.post_status,
    'Post Date': n.post_date,
    'Post URL': n.post_url,
    'Content Type': n.content_type,
    'Working Title': n.working_title,
    'Target Buyer': n.target_buyer,
    'CTA': n.cta_label,
    'CTA Link': n.cta_url,
    'Comments Worth Replying': n.comments_worth_replying,
    'Connection Requests Sent': n.connection_requests_sent,
    'Replies': n.replies,
    'Calls Booked': n.calls_booked,
    'Hours Spent': n.post_hours_spent
  };
  const lead_row = n.lead_id ? {
    'Lead ID': n.lead_id,
    'Contact Name': n.contact_name,
    'Company': n.company,
    'Source Post ID': n.post_id,
    'Source Post URL': n.post_url,
    'Lead Source': n.lead_source,
    'Signal': n.signal,
    'Stage': n.stage,
    'Owner': n.owner,
    'First Contact Date': n.first_contact_date,
    'Estimated Opportunity Value': n.estimated_opportunity_value,
    'Next Follow-Up Date': n.next_follow_up_date,
    'Next Action': n.next_action,
    'Hours Spent': n.lead_hours_spent
  } : { status: 'No lead signal yet' };
  const weekly_review_hint = {
    'Week Start': '2026-05-25',
    'Campaign ID': n.campaign_id,
    'What Worked': 'Pending dogfood cycle',
    'What To Improve': 'Resolve CTA URL and write path after local proof',
    'Next Week Focus': 'Run first live internal LinkedIn Authority loop'
  };
  return { json: { ...item.json, campaign_row, post_row, lead_row, weekly_review_hint } };
});

parameters.content:
# Google Sheets Connector Lane

Staged connector branch. Keep the four Google Sheets nodes disabled until credentials are connected and a spreadsheet is selected. Use the same sheet tabs as the Excel tracker: Campaigns, Posts, Lead Follow-Up, Weekly Review. After mapping passes, this lane can replace or run beside the local Excel writer.
